import urllib.request, json

# Auth
req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login",
    data=json.dumps({"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}).encode(),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
    token = json.loads(r.read()).get("accessToken","")

# GitHub HEAD SHA
req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action",
    data=json.dumps({"action":"github_get_repo_head","input":{"branch":"main"}}).encode(),
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
    GH = json.loads(r.read()).get("result",{}).get("headSha","")

# Render production SHA (live deploy)
req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action",
    data=json.dumps({"action":"render_get_deploy_status","input":{}}).encode(),
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
    d = json.loads(r.read()).get("result",{})
    RENDER = ""
    for entry in d.get("data",[]):
        dep = entry.get("deploy",{})
        if dep.get("status") == "live":
            RENDER = dep.get("commit",{}).get("id","")
            break

# Runtime SHA
with urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.ivxholding.com/health", timeout=30) as r:
    RUNTIME = json.loads(r.read()).get("commit","")

print(f"GitHub HEAD SHA: {GH}")
print(f"Render SHA: {RENDER}")
print(f"Runtime SHA: {RUNTIME}")
if GH and RENDER and RUNTIME and GH == RENDER == RUNTIME:
    print("SHA Match: YES")
else:
    print("SHA Match: NO")
    if GH != RENDER:
        print(f"  Mismatch: GitHub ({GH}) != Render ({RENDER}) — Render is out of sync")
    if GH != RUNTIME:
        print(f"  Mismatch: GitHub ({GH}) != Runtime ({RUNTIME}) — Runtime is out of sync")
    if RENDER != RUNTIME:
        print(f"  Mismatch: Render ({RENDER}) != Runtime ({RUNTIME}) — Runtime does not match deployed Render commit")
PYEOF
